findings.issue: implied-do-variable-not-host-declaration was claimed by a check on an unrelated variable
findings.resolution: A BLOCK host scalar named like the ac-do-variable is observed unchanged; an ordinary-DO mutant aliases it.

findings.issue: index-name-not-host-declaration was claimed by a check on an unrelated variable
findings.resolution: Same construction for a DO CONCURRENT index.

lesson: An outer variable that shares a name with a construct index must come through untouched; that is only proved if the test checks the variable that actually shares the name.
